rationale: The candidate reads coherently across all four views as one stepped, compact mass, so it is not rejected for view inconsistency or colliding solids. The parcel response is acceptable: the form sits within the green boundary and retains a clear oriented footprint rather than merely filling the box. The main weakness is that the blue access edge is not strongly activated; the mass is too sealed at ground level and the open-space figure is minimal. Still, for neighborhood living the visible mass can plausibly support compact mixed-use with a calm upper hierarchy and a reasonable base/upper distinction, so the program fit passes, albeit narrowly. The form resonates most with the stepped/tapered mixed-use/tower references, but it needs a stronger public threshold or court to better satisfy the semantic invariants.
